_meta.source: Carta State of Private Markets 2025 Year in Review / Q1 2026, Carta VC Fund Performance Q4 2025, Cambridge Associates, AngelList, PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor FY2025, PitchBook 2025 Defense Tech Vertical Snapshot, Aventis Advisors 2026, First Round Capital Research
_meta.notes: All monetary values in USD millions. Rates as decimals. Medians where noted. 2026-Q2 refresh: dilution medians, seed-to-A graduation, round timing, exit multiples, and down-round prevalence moved to Carta FY2025/Q1-2026 vintage; Series A->B and B->C transition probabilities retained from earlier vintages (no authoritative 2025+ refresh published) and flagged stale in notes.

seed_to_series_a.note: Seed to A: median 616 days / ~20 months (Carta Q2 2025). Many companies never raise A.

series_a_to_b.note: A to B: ~26 months. Directional 2025 estimate — Carta/SaaStr report A-to-B now exceeds seed-to-A (~2.2yr+); exact 2025 median not published

series_c_to_exit.note: C to exit: highly variable, 18-60 months

stage_transition_probabilities._source: Carta cohort data (mid-2025), Cambridge Associates, First Round Capital, Correlation Ventures

notes.seed_to_a_context: 2-yr graduation collapsed from 30.6% (Q1 2018 cohort) to ~15% (2022-2023 cohorts, Carta mid-2025); ticking back up slightly during 2025. Historic long-run range 20-30%.
notes.stale_flags: series_a_to_b, series_b_to_c, series_c_to_exit retained from pre-2025 vintages; no authoritative refresh published as of 2026-Q2. Directional evidence says A-to-B cycles lengthened materially.
notes.power_law: Top decile of seed companies generate ~65% of returns; top 5 companies took ~19% of all 2025 US VC dollars
notes.vintage_context: 2021-2022 vintages: transition rates depressed vs historical due to valuation reset

dilution_per_round._source: Carta State of Private Markets FY2025 (2025 Year in Review)

pre_seed.note: Carta FY2025: pre-seed median dilution 12.5%; founder-friendly SAFEs

series_a.note: Carta FY2025: Series A median 18-19.5%; seed/A medians remain between 19% and 20%

series_b.note: Carta FY2025: Series B median 12.9%, down from ~15%

series_c.note: Series C+: dilution compresses as company matures (Carta historical ~10-11%; no 2025-specific median published)

ipo_lockup_dilution.note: IPO option pool + underwriter overallotment; assumes no additional dilutive rounds

exit_multiples._source: Aventis Advisors SaaS M&A 2026 (543 deals), PitchBook 2025, SaaS Capital Q1 2026

ma_exit_arr_multiple.note: SaaS M&A: median 4.5x revenue across 543 deals (Aventis, 2015-2026 dataset); top quartile >8x; premium for high-growth/AI-native

ipo_arr_multiple.note: IPO pricing for category leaders. Context: public SaaS trading medians re-rated down to ~3.3x EV/Revenue in Q1 2026 (Aventis/Meritech) on AI-disruption fears; IPO cohort prices above trading comps but the gap compressed

global.note: Secondaries typically 10-20% discount to primary round price

burn_multiple_benchmarks._source: David Sacks / Craft Ventures, a16z internal data
burn_multiple_benchmarks.definition: Net Burn / Net New ARR — lower is better

fair.description: Below rule of 40; growing into efficiency

weak.description: Rule of 40 miss; re-examine unit economics

fund_construction._source: Cambridge Associates, First Round Capital, a16z

power_law_returns.note: Horsley Bridge: top 6% of deals return 60% of capital. 2025 confirmation: top 5 companies took ~19% of all US VC dollars; removing top 5 exits cuts exit totals ~87% (NVCA 2026 Yearbook)

fund_performance_benchmarks._source: Carta VC Fund Performance Q4 2025 (2,500+ funds)

mature_vintage_2017.note: 2017 vintage at ~8 years: median TVPI 1.76-1.95x depending on quarter

recent_vintages.note: 2021/2022 vintages just turned positive in 2025; majority of post-2018 vintages still at $0 DPI

ai_ml_infrastructure.label: AI / ML Infrastructure
ai_ml_infrastructure.description: Foundation models, MLOps, GPU cloud, AI tooling

pre_seed.traction_bar: Strong technical team; prototype or research; some design partners

series_a.traction_bar: $2M-$5M ARR; 120%+ NRR; clear enterprise sales motion

ai_enabled_saas.label: AI-Enabled SaaS
ai_enabled_saas.description: Vertical SaaS with AI layer; AI-native B2B apps

pre_seed.traction_bar: MVP or beta; design partners; team with domain expertise

b2b_saas.label: B2B SaaS
b2b_saas.description: Traditional B2B software; workflow, productivity, operations

pre_seed.traction_bar: Working product; 2-5 design partners; clear ICP

fintech.label: Fintech
fintech.description: Payments, lending, banking infrastructure, wealthtech, insurtech

pre_seed.traction_bar: Regulatory strategy clear; team with banking/fintech background

seed.traction_bar: $400K ARR or $10M+ GMV; regulatory licenses filed

series_a.traction_bar: $2M ARR or $50M+ GMV; full regulatory compliance; enterprise traction

healthtech.label: Healthtech
healthtech.description: Digital health, care delivery, EHR, healthcare SaaS

pre_seed.traction_bar: Clinical validation path; HIPAA compliance plan; 1-2 provider LOIs

seed.traction_bar: $300K ARR; 2-5 health system pilots; HIPAA-compliant infrastructure

series_a.traction_bar: $1.5M ARR; published clinical outcomes; reimbursement pathway

biotech_pharma.label: Biotech / Pharma
biotech_pharma.description: Drug discovery, platform biology, diagnostics, med devices

pre_seed.traction_bar: IND-enabling studies; peer-reviewed publications; strong scientific SAB

seed.traction_bar: Phase 1 initiated or IND filed; platform validated in vivo

series_a.traction_bar: Phase 1 POC data; strategic partnership; platform with 2+ programs

deep_tech_hardware.label: Deep Tech / Hardware
deep_tech_hardware.description: Semiconductors, robotics, quantum, photonics, advanced materials

pre_seed.traction_bar: Technical proof-of-concept; strong IP; world-class technical team

seed.traction_bar: Working prototype; 1-3 LOIs; regulatory pathway defined

series_a.traction_bar: Production-ready; first commercial contracts; manufacturing scale-up plan

consumer.label: Consumer
consumer.description: Consumer apps, media, social, gaming, DTC e-commerce

pre_seed.traction_bar: 1K+ DAU with strong retention (D7 > 20%); viral loop hypothesis

series_a.traction_bar: 1M+ MAU; monetization live; clear path to 10M MAU

climate_energy.label: Climate / Energy
climate_energy.description: Clean energy, carbon, electrification, sustainable agriculture

pre_seed.traction_bar: Technical team; energy/climate policy expertise; pilot site identified

seed.traction_bar: $250K ARR; pilot deployed; policy/regulatory strategy clear

series_a.traction_bar: $1.5M ARR; ITC/IRA incentive clarity; 3+ enterprise contracts

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Two-sided marketplaces; labor, supply chain, B2B procurement

pre_seed.traction_bar: First transactions; supply and demand sides seeded; take rate defined

seed.traction_bar: $2M+ GMV/mo; 5-10% take rate; supply-side liquidity in 1 geography

vertical_saas.label: Vertical SaaS
vertical_saas.description: Industry-specific SaaS: legal, real estate, construction, logistics, etc.

pre_seed.traction_bar: Domain expertise; 2-5 design partners in target vertical; workflow mapped

series_a.traction_bar: $1.5M-$3M ARR; vertical-specific integrations; geographic expansion ready

developer_tools.label: Developer Tools
developer_tools.description: DevOps, security, observability, APIs, dev productivity

pre_seed.traction_bar: Open source traction (500+ GitHub stars) OR 5+ design partners paying

seed.traction_bar: $300K-$1M ARR; PLG motion with enterprise upsell; 2K+ GitHub stars

series_a.traction_bar: $2M-$4M ARR; enterprise deals alongside PLG; security review passing

defense_tech.label: Defense Tech / National Security
defense_tech.description: AI-native defense software, autonomous systems, C2, ISR, cybersecurity for DoD/IC
defense_tech._source: PitchBook 2025 Defense Tech Vertical Snapshot: record $49.1B VC funding in 2025; seed valuations steady (~$17M median pre-money) while early-stage median rose $72M -> $103M post; hot AI-native deals price at 17-50x revenue. Bear multiple lowered from 5.0 in 2026-Q2 refresh — 5x ARR exceeded the global median M&A exit and made defense deals nearly un-failable in scenario models.

pre_seed.traction_bar: Cleared founder or DoD operator background; SBIR Phase I; working prototype for mission use case

seed.traction_bar: $1M-$3M ARR from government contracts; SBIR Phase II or OTA; Secret+ facility clearance

series_a.traction_bar: $4M-$10M ARR; 1+ program of record; TS/SCI facility; clear path to prime contract

comparable_rounds_2024_2025._source: Carta Q4 2025 / Q1 2026, PitchBook, public announcements — illustrative benchmarks only

ai_seed_rounds_2024.note: AI infrastructure seed rounds trading at significant premium vs. other verticals; >60% of Q1 2026 VC dollars went to AI companies (Carta)

b2b_saas_seed_2024.note: Market-wide seed post-money hit a record $24M in Q4 2025 (AI-skewed); non-AI B2B SaaS seed closer to $15-18M

down_round_prevalence_2024.note: Down rounds fell to <14% of Q4 2025 fundings and below 12% by Q1 2026 (Carta) — peak was 22% in 2023

ai_valuation_premium.note: Carta 2025: AI companies price +38% at Series A vs non-AI; foundational-model Series A medians (~$300M) are a separate regime

step_down_structure.description: After deployment period, fees charged on invested capital (net of write-offs)
step_down_structure.note: Effective total fee drag ~8% of fund over typical 10-year life
